lines: Event date: 12 Jun 2026

This is the largest IPO in history
The company is now set to debut on the Nasdaq
With a valuation of over $150 billion

lines: This IPO will provide SpaceX with the necessary funds to pursue its ambitious goals
Including establishing a human settlement on Mars
The success of this IPO is a significant milestone for the private space industry
Source: The Motley Fool, June 12, 2026

slide1.headline: Uncovr Raises €6 Million
slide1.subtitle: To Turn Surgical Video Into Clinical Records

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 10 Jun 2026
Uncovr, a French surgical AI startup, has raised €6 million in funding
The funding will be used to develop its AI technology
The company's technology can turn surgical video into clinical records
This can help improve patient outcomes and reduce costs

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: This funding will help Uncovr to develop its AI technology and bring it to market
The company's technology has the potential to improve patient outcomes and reduce costs
The funding is a significant step forward for Uncovr and the AI industry as a whole
Uncovr's technology can be used in various medical specialties
